title: Chapter 1261
text:
Sorokin's disappearance and the collapse of the Limitless Financial Group had a certain impact on the economy of the galactic society. However, the fall of an oligarch meant that a group of giants had taken over. Many organizations absorbed the nutrients of the Limitless Financial Group and completed the transition. They filled the business gaps caused by the collapse of the Limitless Financial Group and continued to maintain the various services of the galactic society.

In this competition to divide the cake, the Germinal Financial Group relied on Black Star's identity as a shareholder and the military advantage of the army to inherit many of the Limitless Financial Group's trump card businesses and a large number of talents. The scale of the Germinal Financial Group suddenly expanded, and the stock price soared.

After this, although the Limitless Financial Group managed to protect the last bit of its business and survived the storm, it was still greatly damaged. Only a portion of Sorokin's elite children were left to protect the family business.

However, even though the Limitless Financial Group had been dismantled to this extent, it had only fallen from its position as one of the top financial groups in the universe. It could still be considered a first-rate Star Field financial group, which was enough to show how rich Sorokin's wealth was. In terms of making money fair and square, there was probably no one among the Beyond Grade As who was better than him.

If not for the fact that it was inconvenient for Sorokin to appear in public, Han Xiao almost wanted him to be the person in charge of the army's business sector. He had already confirmed that making money was one of Sorokin's few hobbies.

According to Sorokin's own words, the increase in wealth was visible to the naked eye, and it was much easier than the increase in strength. He liked this kind of positive feedback mechanism that snowballed. The increase in his assets made him feel happy both physically and mentally.

However, Han Xiao did not plan to let Sorokin do nothing. He simply let Sorokin handle some of the business affairs behind the scenes. From a boss to a combination of a senior consultant and a professional manager, from others working for him to him working for himself.

Anyway, this guy liked to make money, and since he had nothing to do, letting him continue with his hobby was also a form of entertainment. At most, he would give Sorokin some dividends … He had nowhere to spend it anyway.

In Han Xiao's opinion, the most unlucky ones were the players of the Limitless Financial Group. When the new version was released, their reactions would most likely be the same …

What about my faction? What about such a big faction?

Just thinking about it made Han Xiao feel so greedy … cough, so miserable.

It seemed that he had to use a warm embrace to take in these homeless leeks and let them feel that there was true love in this world.

On the other hand, after the Red Empire issued the arrest warrant for Sorokin, Gaud's incident seemed to have finally come to an end. The dynasty did not do anything else, and peace was restored.

The focus of the galactic society shifted back to the development of the Flickering World. The fourth exploration phase had already ended, ending with the departure of the Supercluster. There were still the fifth, sixth, and so on, all with the theme of peaceful development. The subsequent development basically had nothing to do with the Beyond Grade A allies.

A few months later, the Germinal Financial Group finally finished digesting the 'inheritance' of the Limitless Financial Group and finally submitted a detailed report to Han Xiao.

…

Black Star Palace, Army Commander's Office.

Han Xiao carefully browsed through the financial group's report on the screen. After a long time, he nodded with satisfaction and looked at Sylvia in front of him, as well as Interpais's remote projection.

"You guys did a good job swallowing the businesses of the Limitless Financial Group. The army's expansion of the various Star Fields has taken a huge step forward, saving them at least twenty years of time."

"This is all because of your leadership. You're the lighthouse of the army, guiding us forward." Sylvia smiled flatteringly.

Han Xiao rubbed the back of his hand and said, "I also saw in the report that we recruited some of Sorokin's children, and some even took the initiative to join us …"

"That's because no one can resist your charisma." Sylvia flattered him again.

Han Xiao looked at her strangely.

What happened to this woman today? Didn't she usually ignore me?

Han Xiao ignored her and turned to look at Interpais. "What do you plan to do with Sorokin's children?"

Interpais stroked his mustache and slowly said, "Although Sorokin fled for fear of punishment, his children are basically innocent. Many of them have been receiving elite training and holding senior management positions in the Limitless Financial Group. Of course, I'll let them take the assessment and limit the power in their hands, placing them in management positions at various levels."

"Hmm, we'll do as you say."

Han Xiao's expression did not change, but he was a little worried in his heart.

Does this count as acknowledging a thief as a father?

Alright, with Sorokin's personality, he probably only gave birth to these children to train assistants and would not have too many feelings for them.

It was very common for Beyond Grade As to have children as assistants, but most of them were just making babies normally. In order to increase efficiency, they would at most carry out group activities. Extreme methods like Beast Ancestor were unique in this era.

"The children are indeed not bad. They can be trained from a young age. Maybe it's time for me to make babies …" Han Xiao muttered to himself.

Sylvia's eyes lit up, and she opened her mouth.

"I'm willing! Maternity leave is also a leave. I don't mind! "

Han Xiao was so shocked that he almost slipped under the table.

Wait a minute. Have you become so crazy just to ask for a leave of absence?

Not only do you want to take a leave, but you also want to sleep with the boss. How can there be such a good thing?

Interpais coughed and whispered, "If you want to take maternity leave, I can actually help …"

Sylvia glared at him. "Dream on! Scram!"

Interpais' expression froze. Under Han Xiao's meaningful gaze, he tactfully went offline.

Only the two of them were left in the room. Sylvia suddenly smiled charmingly, swaying her waist as she walked to Han Xiao. She placed her hands on the table, leaned forward, and pressed her lips against Han Xiao's ear. "I wasn't joking just now. Do you have any thoughts about me?"

"You're in heat now? Looks like I'll have to remember today and calculate your cycle. I'll have to avoid you in the future. "

Han Xiao pondered.

Sylvia's face twitched, and her smile stiffened. She forced herself not to explode and said, "Do you really not know how charming you are? My admiration for you has long been overflowing. Do you have the heart to treat me like this?"

"Don't give me that. It doesn't work on me. Just say it."

Han Xiao was unmoved. He pressed his palm on Sylvia's forehead and pushed her head away.

What are you doing? I'm a proper person who has been educated in socialism. I've never done things like 'if there's something to do, I'll do it'. I'm a very proper person.

You usually don't give me any face, but you've turned into a bootlicker today. As the saying goes, one who is unaccountably solicitous is hiding evil intentions. This b * stard definitely has something to ask of me today.

Sylvia's face collapsed, and she kicked Han Xiao's calf. She then rubbed her feet and said angrily,

"I've been the Chief Administrative Official for decades, and you've treated me like a tool. How is this fair? I really can't take it anymore. I want to change my position! "

Han Xiao thought about it and agreed. Although Sylvia was very loyal, she had been a tool for too long, and she would have some opinions in her heart. This was especially so when a Calamity Grade's lifespan was far less than a Beyond Grade A. She had basically devoted most of her youth to the army.

Usually, it was said that the hairline was the durability of an officer, but Han Xiao felt that he was quite humane. As long as the request was reasonable, he would not really treat an officer as a tool.

"Then what do you want?"

"I want you to teach me how to become a Beyond Grade A Super!"

"What?" Han Xiao thought that he had misheard.

"I've done my best for the army and wasted so much time, but you're not even willing to teach me!" Sylvia said angrily.

"That's not it. It's just that the Beyond Grade A Super is all about talent. Even if I teach you, your chances aren't high …" Han Xiao was helpless.

"I don't care. I just want you to teach me!"

Sylvia grabbed Han Xiao's arm and shook it like a spoiled child. She was a decisive and capable Chief Administrative Official in front of outsiders, but in front of Han Xiao, she would occasionally be like before, just a little girl who pestered her teacher.

"Alright, alright. After the handover, you can return to being my student." Han Xiao could only agree.

Hearing this, Sylvia smiled brightly, kissed Han Xiao's cheek, and ran away like a thief who had stolen a chicken.

When she reached the door, Sylvia's footsteps paused, and she looked back with a smile like a lively elf. Her face was slightly red, and her tone was mischievous.

"Regarding my previous suggestion, I was really not joking."

Then, without waiting for Han Xiao's reaction, she ran away as fast as she could.

"Tsk, like hell I'll believe you." Han Xiao shook his head and wiped off the lipstick mark on his face.

Thinking of his previous life, Sylvia could only wander the universe aimlessly after her father was imprisoned. Now that the army had given her a home and a goal to fight for, Han Xiao could not help but feel emotional.

Unknowingly, many people's fates had been changed because of him.

"Sylvia's potential should not be enough to reach the Beyond Grade A realm, but nothing is absolute. Even trash like Kohler and Beyoni could reach the Beyond Grade A realm. With my guidance, Sylvia might have some hope … Depending on the situation, I'll teach her some knowledge from Jayz's treasure."

Han Xiao nodded.

Beep beep beep …

At this time, his communicator suddenly rang. He took it out and saw that it was a call from Ames.

Sylvia had just left, and now Ames was calling him?

"What a coincidence. Is this a woman's sixth sense?"

Han Xiao shuddered inwardly.

He calmed himself down and picked up the call.

Ames's figure appeared on the screen. She held her chin with one hand and had an elegant smile on her face.

"We haven't seen each other in a while. Do you want to come and chat with me? Aesop brewed a new batch of wine. "

"That's it? I'm not going! "

"Also … I miss you a little." Ames blinked.

"Let's go."

Han Xiao did not say anything and immediately switched to the King.

In the past few years, other than the regular meetings, he had not seen Ames in private much. He had only been thinking about plotting and researching machinery, so he felt a little apologetic. Furthermore, he had just completed a major task, so he needed a little rest.
